opportunities.name: Tailwind attack skater
opportunities.objective: Use bonus movement speed as documented on-hit magic damage.
opportunities.mechanic: Tailwind adds 0.3 times a movement-speed stat expression to attacks and Zephyr; Zephyr's passive grants speed with an AP term. Nashor and Dusk and Dawn reward real attacks, Stormrazor grants a brief energized speed burst, and Ardent can buff Janna after shielding an ally. Q disruption and self E help tolerate the attack-range risk.
opportunities.requiredState: Need movement buffs active, an allied shield target for Ardent and safe repeated attacks.
opportunities.failure: Casting Zephyr may alter passive availability; Q/R disengage can move targets outside attack range.
opportunities.test: Compare on-hit damage with speed buffs active versus expired and record empowered attack frequency.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Tailwind's raw movement stat flag is not proof that all displayed total speed converts to damage.

opportunities.name: Shield refund damage support
opportunities.objective: Convert repeated movement impairment into more allied AD shielding.
opportunities.mechanic: Eye of the Storm adds AD while its shield survives and refunds 20% cooldown when Janna impairs champion movement with an ability. Q/W/R can provide the impairment, while Helia charges from real damage before an allied shield. Staff grants AP/haste after shielding and Mandate serves actual Q/R immobilization; Shurelya helps allies reach Janna's formation.
opportunities.requiredState: Need shields surviving long enough to use AD and repeated safe impairment hits.
opportunities.failure: Burst instantly removes the shield AD, or aggressive damage fishing exposes Janna to engage.
opportunities.test: Measure E cooldown refunds, shield uptime and ally attack damage during a controlled two-target peel.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Current Mandate requires immobilization; Zephyr's slow alone cannot be assumed to mark.

ruledOut.reason: Moving or using an ability ends R; it cannot sustain a simultaneous full attack combo.

unknowns: Tailwind movement statFormula meaning, Zephyr passive loss and Helia charge timing need live checks.

builds.name: Tailwind attack skater
builds.summary: Use bonus movement speed as documented on-hit magic damage.
builds.goal: Use bonus movement speed as documented on-hit magic damage.
builds.hypothesis: Tailwind adds 0.3 times a movement-speed stat expression to attacks and Zephyr; Zephyr's passive grants speed with an AP term. Nashor and Dusk and Dawn reward real attacks, Stormrazor grants a brief energized speed burst, and Ardent can buff Janna after shielding an ally. Q disruption and self E help tolerate the attack-range risk.
testPlan: Required state: Need movement buffs active, an allied shield target for Ardent and safe repeated attacks.
Compare on-hit damage with speed buffs active versus expired and record empowered attack frequency.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Casting Zephyr may alter passive availability; Q/R disengage can move targets outside attack range.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Tailwind's raw movement stat flag is not proof that all displayed total speed converts to damage.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Stormrazor, Ardent Censer, Dusk and Dawn, Cosmic Drive, Boots of Swiftness. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
